items.html: But when the Hochma mentioned coupled with Bina, which is the throat, for the need of ZON, it was not in the manner mentioned, since it was necessary that these two luminaries not be equal, and that one be greater than the other, one the great luminary and one the small luminary, to lead the lower ones as written; therefore, in this coupling of now, SAG did not serve there except merely as a passage, and the drop came out from there in the name AB. For every drop comes out only from there, as mentioned, and it passed through, merely as a passage, through the name SAG, and descended to the MA and BON of this Hochma, and there it also received illumination from both of them, for they are the root of ZON. And then, from the MA, ZA was drawn, and from the BON, the Nukva was drawn.
